summary: Implemented fix for KAFKA-20332 by modifying AsyncKafkaConsumer.collectFetch() to properly wait for reconciliation check completion while respecting wakeup signals. This prevents a race condition where records could be returned for revoked partitions. The fix creates a wrapper CompletableFuture for the reconciliation check, registers it with the wakeup trigger, and ensures the wait can be interrupted by wakeup signals. All 119 AsyncKafkaConsumerTest tests pass, including testPollWaitsForReconciliationCheckComplete() and testWakeupWhileWaitingOnReconciliationCheck().
